title: Cambridge Analytica Uncovered: Secret filming reveals election tricks
summary: A Channel 4 News undercover investigation in which Cambridge Analytica executives are filmed discussing bribes, honeypots, fake identities and manipulating elections around the world.
why: HN points to it as the primary evidence of what Cambridge Analytica was willing to do, especially in Facebook data scandal threads.

quote.text: I highly recommend watching the report, it's a fascinating watch.
